reply_text:
I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics changed hands on **Nov 3, 2025**.

That date comes from Moss's Coastal digest of Sun 2025-11-02, which says the account changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". It's the only source I found. It doesn't name Kwame as the new owner, and I found no contract or account record to confirm either point.

I also told her that "PHL" is also shorthand for Covey & Lark Retail, so she should check the org ID before logging it in the tracker.
